}}'''Soran Milo''' was an author who lived circa 400NE and wrote ''[[The Killers of the Black Veil]]'', a book detailing the Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Soran Milo}}

==History==
Although he tried hard to collect accurate information on the Aiel from second hand accounts, according the Aiel he still go most everything wrong in the book he wrote. He stayed at a ''stedding'' and talked with travelers that had visited the Waste.{{ref/book|4|22}}
